dedupe_keys.name: barcelona home to school pedestrian gps trajectories

description: The CORA research data repository publishes home-to-school pedestrian GPS trajectories from ten schools in the Barcelona metropolitan area. Its own Dataverse record lists 194 files and a CC0 1.0 licence. The article reports 83 processed journeys, with separate cleaned and one-second interpolated series after trimming route endpoints to reduce disclosure risk. These observations can calibrate pedestrian route-choice or walking-speed assumptions near schools. A caveat is that students volunteered for a single-day exercise and their routes do not represent all travellers or ordinary weeks. Interpolated positions are calculated values and should be distinguished from recorded fixes. The article also cites a Zenodo report; its Data Records reference points instead to this CORA dataset DOI. I read the own Dataverse API and article Data Records without downloading participant tracks, assessing privacy claims or fitting a movement model. No directly related catalogue record was identified. Coverage is ten schools in the Barcelona metropolitan area.
